text:
tom: Follow-up from the postmortem: repeating pattern across three areas -> missing spans from dropped trace headers, aggregation spikes from ETL replays, and intermittent lag after checkpoint GC. Need single owners, short timelines, and a conservative backfill plan.
nilay: I'll own trace/header fixes in the edge and SDK. Plan: add header assertion + CI integration test, deploy behind flag. ETA 48h, 24h canary. Rollback: disable flag. Blocker: confirm CDN removes no headers.
rachel: I'll handle ETL checkpoint durability and add a lightweight dedupe pass in the ingestion worker. Timeline: durable checkpoints to S3 + idempotency check. ETA 4 business days.
kevin: I'll coordinate the backfill runbook and maintenance window. Suggest dry-run on staging then live during 03:00 UTC low traffic. Backfill window: 2026-03-20T00:00Z -> 2026-03-20T06:00Z.
ops-bot: Postmortem published: https://confluence.redwood.example/pm/201845 4 owners assigned.
tom: Can each owner paste a 1-line verification query and the core backfill SQL snippet? Ops needs perms ahead of time.
nilay: verification (simple):
```bash
# ensure header arrives at service
curl -H "X-Trace-ID: hdr-test" https://edge-test.redwood/api/ping | grep hdr-test || exit 1
```
rachel: core backfill SQL (dedupe by request_id):
```sql
INSERT INTO metrics_rollup_staging (metric, window_start, value)
SELECT metric, window_start, SUM(value)
FROM (
  SELECT metric, window_start, value,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY request_id, metric, window_start ORDER BY event_ts DESC) rn
  FROM raw_events
  WHERE event_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-20T00:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-20T06:00:00Z'
) t
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY metric, window_start;
```
tom: Success criteria proposals: missing spans <0.05% within 24h of canary; rollup diffs <0.25% after backfill; ETL processing lag <60s steady-state. Object if unrealistic.
kevin: I'll request DB replica slot and schedule 03:00-04:30 UTC maintenance window. Will post runbook with dry-run checklist and validate queries.
infra-bot: IAM checklist: grant rollup_writer role to backfill job; confirm snapshot retention for 7 days.
nilay: I'll ping @cdn-team and @mobile-leads for header passthrough confirmation.
rachel: I'll add unit tests and an integration smoke in CI to assert no duplicate rollup keys for synthetic traffic.
tom: Deadlines: nilay (header PR + CI test) by EOD+2, rachel (checkpoint + dedupe PR) by EOD+4, kevin (runbook + schedule) by EOD+1. Update thread if anything slips.
ops-bot: Reminder created: 2018459999-owners-checkin scheduled 2026-03-21T09:00:00Z.
tom: Thanks all. Keep updates short in-thread; we'll confirm after dry-run and canary.
